It is believed to represent the divine aspect of personal freedom and autonomy, which is celebrated in Hindu spirituality. In Hindu mythology, the goddesses Saraswati and Durga are often referred to as Aparna, meaning 'without any relationship to anyone else'. These goddesses embody the qualities of self-sufficient, independent, and autonomous beings, which are qualities that Apnavi embodies as well. Additionally, the name Apnavi can be seen as a reminder of the Hindu belief that each individual soul is unique and has the potential for spiritual growth and liberation.
